meta.scope: Archive-wide exact enterprise CPU matches; 1/2 CPUs; rint2017 base rate
meta.selectionBasis: The two newest official submission IDs per exact CPU model and CPU count across all indexed quarters, plus the fixed list of previously verified reports. Submission ID order is not publication-date order. This selection broadens model coverage without importing every system disclosure; no score-based selection.
meta.sourceLimitations: Published scores describe the tested CPU, memory, OS, compiler and tuning. CPU2017 and CPU2026 scales are separate. CPU2026 test builds must remain separate comparison cohorts. Index coverage does not mean every catalog CPU has a public result. CPU2017 system reports are sampled by submission recency; use --all-reports for an exhaustive import.
meta.trademarkNotice: SPEC CPU and SPECrate are registered trademarks of the Standard Performance Evaluation Corporation.
meta.retrievalDateMeaning: snapshotDate is index discovery date; each row's retrievedDate is its actual disclosure fetch date. Offline replay never changes either date.
